title: Going on Safari as a Solo Traveller
excerpt: Going on safari alone is easier than you think. Private or group, single supplements and safety tips.
body:
More and more people go on safari alone. Tanzania is a good destination for it.

## Private or group

- **Private:** your own vehicle and guide, full freedom, higher price.
- **Group:** share with others, social, lower price. See [private or group safari](/blog/private-vs-group-safari/).

## Single supplement

Many lodges charge a supplement for single occupancy. Some camps have special single rooms.

## Social

At camps, meals are often shared, so you easily meet other travellers.

## Safety

You are always with a guide. Many solo women travel in Tanzania. See [safety tips](/blog/tanzania-safety-tips/).

## Combine

With a [solo Kilimanjaro climb](/blog/kilimanjaro-solo-climb/) or Zanzibar.

[Plan your solo safari](/travel-proposal/).
